points: 15 illustrative risk cohorts cover 1,118 CVE entries; largest: Windows filesystems, storage and backup (136)
Microsoft: for many customers the priority is to install updates as soon as possible
Cohorts do not replace review of actively exploited or high-severity flaws
read: MSRC blog 'Using risk cohorts to prioritize security updates', 13 October 2026
take: Press tallies put October's Patch Tuesday at about 1,400 fixes, a record. Microsoft now groups CVEs by shared exposure so teams can triage at this volume; one zero-day is exploited.
title: Microsoft: record October patch release, sorted into 15 risk cohorts
